newsitem.title: MALTA: Malta share index gains 18 points.
newsitem.headline: Malta share index gains 18 points.

text.p: The share index rose by 18.37 points at the Malta stock exchange on Wednesday on the strength of gains in the share price of the listed banks.
Market turnover topped 1.7 million Malta pounds from 400,000 Malta pounds the week before in the once-a-week trading session with trading in equities reaching 80,622 pounds.
The biggest gains were made by Mid-Med Bank with 8,670 shares being traded in seven deals for an average 166.2 cents per share, up 5.6 cents.
Prices in Bank of Valletta gained 3.7 cents, with 29,752 shares selling in 33 deals for an average 133.3 cents.
Average prices in Lombard Bank rose by 3.8 cents, with 4,917 shares selling for an average 155.7 cents in seven deals.
Average prices in Middle Sea Insurance lost a cent, with 100 shares selling in one deal for 121 cents.

There were three deals in Simonds Farsons Cisk, with 2,846 shares selling for an average of 49.3 cents, down seven mils. Farsons 8.5 percent preference shares gained six mils however, with 1,500 shares selling in four deals for an average of 97 cents each.
Suncrest Hotels shares gained eight mils, with 22,500 shares selling in five deals for an average 70.8 cents.
Trading in government bonds saw a turnover of 1.5 million pounds, with dealing in 22 securities.

There were two deals in 6.5 percent Gasan bonds 1998/99 at 98.9 cents each, unchanged. There was one deal in 7.25 percent Mid-Med Bank unsubordinated loan stock 2005 at 98.5 cents, no change, and two deals in 8.25 percent Suncrest Bonds 2005/7 at 100.4 , also no change
